en: Changed Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8 and Fable 5 to stop holding their launch-default effort over `/effort` in `-p` or the Agent SDK, a project, managed or `--settings` `effortLevel`, or a per-model level
zh: 变更 Opus 4.7、Opus 4.8 和 Fable 5，不再让它们的启动默认 effort 覆盖 `-p` 或 Agent SDK 中的 `/effort`、项目级、托管级或 `--settings` 的 `effortLevel`，以及按模型设置的级别
